notes: Swahili methali completion pack, draft 1. Kept separate from the English bank pending review by a fluent Swahili editor. Options are answer-first; the game can shuffle them.

puzzles.explanation: Methali hii inashauri kuepuka pupa, kwa sababu kufanya jambo kwa haraka kupita kiasi kunaweza kuharibu matokeo.
Methali hii inasisitiza kuwa ushirikiano husaidia kufanikisha kazi ngumu.
puzzles.subtitle_en: One finger cannot crush a louse.

puzzles.explanation: Mtu hufundishwa au kuelekezwa vizuri akiwa bado mdogo na mwenye uwezo wa kujifunza.
puzzles.subtitle_en: Bend the fish while it is still fresh.

puzzles.hint: Sehemu ya mwili inayotajwa ni ya kutembelea.
puzzles.explanation: Kutokufuata ushauri mzuri kunaweza kuleta madhara yanayoweza kuepukika.
puzzles.subtitle_en: Who ignores wise counsel may break a leg.

puzzles.hint: Methali hii inahusu kuweka rasilimali kwa ajili ya baadaye.
puzzles.explanation: Kuweka akiba husaidia wakati wa mahitaji ya baadaye; akiba haipotezi thamani yake kwa sababu tu imehifadhiwa.

puzzles.hint: Mwisho wa methali unarudia mtu aliyeepuka kumrekebisha mtoto.
puzzles.explanation: Kuepuka kumwelekeza mtoto anapohitaji kurekebishwa kunaweza kusababisha matatizo makubwa baadaye.
puzzles.subtitle_en: Who fears a child's crying may end up crying themselves.

puzzles.hint: Kitu kigumu kinaweza kumalizika kwa hatua ndogo ndogo.
puzzles.explanation: Juhudi ndogo zinazofanywa kwa uthabiti zinaweza kukamilisha kazi kubwa.
puzzles.subtitle_en: Little by little finishes the log.

puzzles.hint: Mtu akitaka kitu kilicho chini ya kitanda, lazima afanye nini?
puzzles.explanation: Kupata unachotaka mara nyingi huhitaji juhudi, unyenyekevu na kuchukua hatua.
puzzles.subtitle_en: Who wants what is under the bed must bend down.

puzzles.explanation: Watu wanaposhirikiana huwa na nguvu zaidi; migawanyiko huwadhoofisha.
puzzles.subtitle_en: Unity is strength; division is weakness.

puzzles.hint: Nia ikiwapo, mtu anaweza kupata njia ya kufanikisha jambo.
puzzles.explanation: Azma na juhudi vinaweza kusaidia kupata suluhisho au njia ya kufikia lengo.
puzzles.subtitle_en: Where there is a will, there is a way.
